# Fixtures for `lnk` (Windows shortcut)

Files two shortcuts made for whiff's tests (CC0-1.0) and two of Eric Zimmerman's test files (MIT, © Eric Zimmerman). Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/forensic.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tide-table.lnk` | pylnk3 create: notepad.exe with arguments and a working folder | CC0-1.0 |
| `approaches.lnk` | pylnk3 create: a network share target | CC0-1.0 |
| `ez-win10.lnk` | Lnk/Lnk.Test/TestFiles/Win10 | MIT |
| `ez-winxp.lnk` | Lnk/Lnk.Test/TestFiles/WinXP | MIT |
